description: This Java source file defines an exception class 'AttributeNotModifiableException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that an attempt to modify a specific attribute of a 'Thing' failed due to insufficient permissions or other issues, and includes mechanisms for building and parsing such exceptions.
